result.instructions: Tools for Catalog Machine, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products in the Apparel category cost more than 20 dollars?"; "Show my open orders from this week."; "Rebuild the PDF of my Spring catalog and tell me when it has finished.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Catalog Machine data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run catalogmachine_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run catalogmachine_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run catalogmachine_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. catalogmachine_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with all fields, variants and collections. Filter by category or collection. Catalog Machine API: GET /products.

tools.name: catalogmachine_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by its Code, with all fields and variants. Catalog Machine API: GET /products/{code}.

tools.name: catalogmachine_update_product
tools.title: Update a product
tools.description: WRITE. Change fields of one product. The tool reads the product, merges your `fields` over it, and sends the full record back (the API needs the whole structure). Top-level keys only, for example Name, Price, Description. Variants and Collections replace the old list if you pass them. Catalog Machine API: GET then POST /products/{code}.

fields.description: Fields to change, for example {"Price":"15.99","Description":"New text"}. The Code cannot change.

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories with their field definitions. Catalog Machine API: GET /categories.

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (open orders by default), with customer and line items. Filter by status. Catalog Machine API: GET /orders.

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_catalogs
tools.title: List catalogs
tools.description: List catalogs with permalink, status, privacy and the HTML and PDF links. Catalog Machine API: GET /catalogs.

tools.name: catalogmachine_rebuild_catalog
tools.title: Rebuild a catalog PDF
tools.description: WRITE. Start a rebuild of the catalog PDF by permalink. Returns a JobId: check it with catalogmachine_get_catalog_job. Catalog Machine API: GET /catalogs/{permalink}/rebuild.

tools.name: catalogmachine_get_catalog_job
tools.title: Get a catalog rebuild job
tools.description: Get the status, errors and warnings of a catalog rebuild job. Catalog Machine API: GET /jobs/catalogs/{jobId}.

job_id.description: The JobId from catalogmachine_rebuild_catalog (the catalog permalink).

tools.name: catalogmachine_get_import_job
tools.title: Get an import job
tools.description: Get the status of the last Shopify import job (`shopify`) or CSV import job (`csv`). Catalog Machine API: GET /jobs/import/shopify-import or /jobs/import/csv-import.
